content_html:
Be Trendy is a tool for your self-expression through stylish skincare and daily inspiration. We believe that beauty is multifaceted, and every girl is unique in her style, passions, and way of life. The brand was created to support each one and to highlight the individuality of every style, no matter what kind of person you are.

Be Trendy – Highlights Your Style!

Be Trendy - Your style – be different, be yourself!

Each Be Trendy collection combines the needs of the modern woman, high-quality professional formulas, and sophisticated fragrances that last on the skin for up to 12 hours.

SHIMMER LINE cosmetics provide elegant, long-lasting radiance, skin care, and a delicate aromatic trail. Perfect for enhancing your look at any event. The bath collection is ideal for relaxation rituals, relieves fatigue, and adds charm before a date.

CARE LINE offers at-home skincare with active formulas that contain over 20 powerful ingredients and natural oils, delivering a “glow from within and skin rejuvenation” effect.
